hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'lsof.*\|.*(xargs )?kill' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\-sTCP:LISTEN'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Use -sTCP:LISTEN with lsof to avoid killing browser/client processes. Example: lsof -ti:PORT -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9"}'; exit 2; fi; }
